newsitem.title: USA: Moog Inc. to buy Moog Controls for $48 million.
newsitem.headline: Moog Inc. to buy Moog Controls for $48 million.

text.p: Moog Inc., a maker of controls used by the aerospace and defence businesses, said Monday it has agreed to buy Moog Controls Inc. from International Motion Control Inc. for $48.6 million.
Moog Controls was formed in 1988 when Moog Inc. exchanged the company's U.S. Industrial Hydraulics Division for stock held by Bill Moog, the company's founder.
Moog Inc. Chairman and Chief Executive R. T. Brady said in a statement that the acquisition would complement the company's overseas industrial and its aerospace businesses in the United States.
The acquisition is expected to be completed next month.
The stock of Moog Inc. was off 37.5 cents at $22.75 on the American Stock Exchange.
